name: Iconography — Phosphor
description: The Phosphor icon set (CDN-loaded, regular weight by default) at a 24px default size, with a defined size ramp and a 48px minimum touch target for tappable icons.
notes: Icon set: house, magnifying-glass, fork-knife, shopping-cart-simple, heart, star, storefront, motorcycle, map-pin, clock, receipt, credit-card, bell, sliders-horizontal, user (Phosphor, ph-* classes). A 24px glyph sits centered in a 48px tap target with 12px padding on each side.
